typography.family: system-ui with Noto Sans Devanagari fallback

must: Keep the existing class and miscellaneous-topic destinations
Use existing shared CSS tokens and static assets
avoid: Changing lesson functionality or curriculum structure
Replacing existing site navigation or language behavior

decisions.choice: Refine the homepage hero and class discovery hierarchy while preserving the established white, blue-accent learning-site identity and all existing destinations.
decisions.rationale: Make the learning approach and primary class entry clearer without changing the established curriculum or interactions.

decisions.choice: Add a focused, notebook-inspired document-formatting workspace within the existing white-and-blue learning system. Use a guided four-step mission, compact native controls, a live paper preview, and immediate bilingual explanations.
decisions.rationale: Students learn formatting by changing one property at a time and seeing its effect on the same document. This extends the existing notice builder without replacing chapter navigation, language controls, curriculum, or the static HTML/CSS/vanilla-JS architecture.
references: UI/UX Pro Max: accessibility, touch target, mobile-first, semantic feedback, reduced motion guidance
